declared_limits: Full entry notional is held until exit_time: after a TP1 partial the runner is half size, TP1 timing is not in the ledger, so the intra-hold exposure path is an UPPER BOUND; the exact path is UNVERIFIABLE from the committed record.
Equity at entry is taken from the committed -29r all-bar equity series (basis A: last mark <= entry; basis B: first mark >= entry); the two bases bound the simulator's own event-time marked equity.
Samples are entry event timestamps only (the spec's per-event-timestamp reporting on the recorded event grid).
Heat (planned risk / equity, capped at 5%) is a different quantity and is never reported here as exposure.
